notes.title: Project Horror Tales 3.0 Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Project Horror Tales 3.0 Playtest is open for all.[/h2]
[h3]This is a demo for hardware testing and to allow beta testers for the Full Release build.[/h3]
[h3]For any bugs/Issue please join the discord to report them.
